title: AI Production Monitoring Lab
description: Monitor an AI assistant in production and test the monitoring itself: tracing, online evals, drift (PSI), p95 latency, guardrails, shadow releases, incident triage and feedback loops, with CI gates and negative controls. No API key needed.
